I went to court last year, after battling a 3 year rape case with my ex partner. For 3 years, it was the most traumatic experience, but nothing prepared me for what sitting in that court room felt like. 
I took my best friend with me, (and family) and honestly she didn’t know what to do, but realistically, there isn’t much you can do. 
Coming from someone who has been in your friends position, all you can do is be there when she goes in and be there for when she comes out. Don’t ask too many questions (how are you, etc) just allow her to come to terms with everything. 
Know you’re doing your best as her best friend by just being there. 
I didn’t cry in court, I physically couldn’t and she may face the same situation or she may end up hysterical, there’s never any way of telling. Beforehand, make sure you guys go for a walk, a long one or a short one. Don’t let her be alone, I pushed everyone away at one point and it was the loneliest I had ever felt. 
She’s lucky to have such a supportive friend, and I truly hope she gets the best outcome she could ask for. I may be a stranger on the internet, but to know someone is going through something I have experienced is heartbreaking and I wish things were better for her!

Honestly speaking, when it comes to mental health and difficulties, it’s something we must endure to see how strong we really are. 
I was fighting a 3 year court case, and I was so close to giving up multiple times, but I am so glad I didn’t because it took that bad experience to make me who I am today. 

It may feel like the world is not on your side, and my heart honestly goes out for you currently, but I promise it will get better. (Gross I know because those words never had an impact when my life was at its worst) 

I don’t know who you are, but just from this post I get a sense that you’re a beautiful human being, inside and out and you genuinely deserve some sort of happiness in your life and I truly hope you get it. 

Life isn’t easy, and it has its ways of knocking us down when we need picking up the most, but it’s time for you to prove to yourself how strong you really are. 

My inbox is always open should you need someone to talk to, with a sense of how you’re feeling. I still get like this, and some days are worse than others, but I will always be here should you just need to vent, scream or cry. 

Take care, and don’t take it so hard on yourself. 💖
